purpose: Bounded repair and final-code qualification; stop before PR-EG.
executive_summary:
# 01 — Executive Summary

**C — PR-EF REQUIRES FURTHER REPAIR. Stop before PR-EG.**

The three original social failures are repaired in recorded replay and fresh final-code production requests. A continuous eleven-turn final-code /api/chat conversation passes: GM observation/follow-up, explicit and implicit NPC questions, knowledge limitation, GM clarification of the latest NPC reply, incidental gesture, inspection, withdrawal and established movement. This is real production ASGI HTTP with fresh interpretation/narration, no provider fixtures, and one persistent initialized disposable campaign.

The existing contract now consumes validated bridge ASK identity and resolver identity; unknown knowledge stays separate from unknown target. Terminal fallbacks are validated and cannot manufacture a passing seal. Conservative posture normalization preserves consequential secondary operations. Notice-board test now validates canonical referent and disclosed content.

Fresh production holdouts pass 24/24 original and 5/9 additional expressions. Explicit NPC ownership, implicit continuation, correction and ambiguous addressee failures in the additional set prevent acceptance. The ambiguous request incorrectly consumes a turn and advances passive world state, a critical authorization/state-integrity failure. These are preserved as failures, not removed or rewritten. Final recorded replay is 24/24 original, 5/9 additional. Existing regression family: 293 pass/26 fail → 321 pass/20 fail, with 6 resolved and 0 new failing identities. Twenty-two added targeted checks pass. Active campaign preservation: True.

The work supports continued bounded repair, not architectural replacement. Do not begin PR-EG. Broader dialogue defects and performance limitations remain documented.

production: Carry validated ASK/social identity and compact authoritative result.
Normalize bounded incidental scope and public latest-reply guidance.
Retain incidental/secondary context and latest emitted NPC reply; avoid body-head movement.
Validate known identity/interaction and fail closed on invalid terminal fallback.
validation: Reconcile two retired speaker-mutator assertions with current sealed validation.
documentation: Generate reproducible review and exact identity/signature audits.

testing.full_suite: Established family only; full suite not run.
testing.runtime_validation: Final-code 11-turn continuous conversation and three original expressions pass.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: gpt-4.1-mini; 134 requests; recorded runs labeled separately.

campaign_specific: Four additional fresh production ownership/correction/ambiguity failures, including one unauthorized turn/state advance.
Large strict-social prompts and retry cost.
pre_existing: Twenty inherited regression failures; see exact signatures/classification.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Review C recommendation; do not begin PR-EG.
does_not_prove: Fresh isolated final-code interpretation score for all 33.
recommended_next_step: External PR-EF-R2 review; further bounded repair before PR-EG.
